art_direction.typography_logic: Large meaning-unit headlines, compact labels, readable Japanese body text.
art_direction.composition_logic: A narrow reading rail interrupted by one evidence-bearing offset surface; peaks are separated by quiet chapters.
art_direction.photography_logic: No client image is required for the sample; use generated SVG/CSS geometry until rights are cleared.
art_direction.icon_logic: No generic icon wall; use line markers tied to the process sequence.
art_direction.texture_logic: Subtle ruled-paper and calibration marks, never a decorative grain overlay.
art_direction.motion_logic: One restrained reveal for section entry; no infinite or blocking animation.
art_direction.craft_catch: A calibration line carries the customer from the current situation to the next contact point.
